about: Documentation that must be true: every example in docs/USAGE.md is run against the real CLI. The agent may only run the tests, not the CLI, so it has to read the code.

goals.title: A usage guide whose examples work
goals.objective: A new user can copy any example from the guide and it works.

todos.text: Write docs/USAGE.md for tally's command line. Cover every command (total, report, list, and list's --page and --size) with an example that works exactly as written on data/transactions.csv, written as `tally <command> ...` on its own line in a code block, and show what each prints.
